prompt: On a map drawn on a coordinate plane, each unit stands for 1 meter. A rectangular garden has corners at (-10, 5), (22, 5), (22, 23) and (-10, 23). A fence will go all the way around the garden except for a gate that is 4 meters wide. How many meters of fence are needed?
explanation: The bottom side goes from (-10, 5) to (22, 5). The points are on opposite sides of the y-axis, so its length is 10 + 22 = 32 meters. The right side goes from (22, 5) to (22, 23).
